plans.name: Google Antigravity / Free
plans.scope_zh: Antigravity 免费周额度
plans.note_zh: 美国美元月费，其他地区及税费以结算页为准；Google AI 共享订阅仅登记一次，可用于聊天与 Antigravity。免费 / Plus 的 Agent 额度按周刷新；Pro 和 Ultra 有五小时与周窗口，官方未给出固定请求数。付费档超额可选择消耗另购 AI credits；不换算成 tokens。

plans.models_note_en: These are Antigravity core reasoning models, not every model across other bundled products. Claude Sonnet/Opus 4.6 and GPT-OSS 120B are scheduled for removal on 2026-11-02.

offers.conditions_zh: 免费个人账号的基础周额度；模型与地区限制遵循官方表，旧 Claude 4.6 与 GPT-OSS 模型预计 11 月 2 日移除。
offers.conditions_en: Baseline weekly quota for free individual accounts; official model and regional restrictions apply. Older Claude 4.6 and GPT-OSS models are scheduled for removal on November 2.
offers.eligibility_zh: 受支持地区的个人 Google 账号，服务资格以官方为准
offers.eligibility_en: Individual Google accounts in supported regions, subject to official eligibility
